description: Online retailer specializing in home electronics and lifestyle products

products.competitive_advantages: Curated selection with expert reviews, same-day shipping in Sofia
products.ad_notes: Google Shopping for spring collection launched March 5. Brand keyword bids +20% since March 7.

competitors.name: Competitor B

what_changed.campaign_changes: Paused Meta retargeting March 3 (budget to Google). New Google Shopping campaign for spring collection March 5. Brand keyword bids +20% March 7.
